request.query: COMPARE glyph("d1") TO glyph("d2") AT SEGMENT deal.metrics

reasons.reflex: act: the records back the top outcome and nothing stands against it
reasons.insufficient: no record is close enough to this situation, or too few of the top outcome are
reasons.unseen: the situation carries a key or a value no win has recorded; they are listed in `unseen`
reasons.vetoed: a recorded failure of the top outcome is as close as its wins and newer than them
reasons.uncalibrated: fewer records than the model's scale takes, and none is the same situation
reasons.mismatch: the records differ from the situation under a key the model's scale says must match
reasons.low_confidence: the records disagree on the outcome

act.description: Branch on this. True only when `reason` is reflex.

top.description: The leading outcome. Null when nothing is close enough.

sufficient.description: Some record clears the model's similarity floor.

exact.description: The same situation is on record. A lexical match is never exact.

unseen.description: What the situation carries that no win has recorded: a key ("force") or a value ("target=main").

confidence.description: The top outcome's share of the vote among the records that clear the floor.

support.description: How close those records are, on average.

items.description: One situation on record with one outcome, however many times it was recorded.

key.description: The situation's identity: the same for the same data in any key order.

score.description: The exact weighted share of the query this situation agrees with. 1 is the same situation.

sim.description: The same number as `score`, under its earlier name.

veto_match.description: How close the nearest recorded failure of the top outcome is.

lifted.description: A close failure exists, and a newer win outranks it.

match.description: At a leaf both sides carry: how the two values compare. partial is two sets or texts that share some of their items; near is two numbers some bins apart on one scale.
